entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have inflation
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin nima inflacije

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Inflacija pomeni, da vaš denar sčasoma kupi manj. Bitcoin je dober denar, ker nima inflacije.

entries.englishValue: because it has a maximum supply of 21 million Bitcoin. No one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.targetTranslation: , s trdo zgornjo mejo 21 milijonov bitcoinov. Nihče ne more ustvariti več.

entries.englishValue: Dollars have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.
entries.targetTranslation: Ponudba avstralski dolarja je neomejena, kar pomeni, da se ga lahko kadar koli natisne še več.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is scarce
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je redek

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Zgodovinsko je Bitcoin sčasoma pridobival kupno moč, medtem ko jo je avstralski dolar izgubljal. Mnogi uporabljajo Bitcoin kot dolgoročni varčevalni račun — denar, ki ga puščajo rasti leta, ne da bi se ga dotaknili.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Bi raje varčevali v avstralskih dolarjih, ki sčasoma kupijo manj? Ali v Bitcoinu, ki je sčasoma kupil več?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je tudi orodje svobode

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Omrežja Bitcoin nihče ne nadzoruje. Ne upravlja ga nobena vlada ali podjetje. Zgrajen je tako, da ščiti vašo svobodo in vaš denar.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Ljudje po vsem svetu že uporabljajo Bitcoin za zaščito svoje svobode — tudi ko jim njihove vlade nočejo pomagati ali jih poskušajo ustaviti.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Australian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Če varčujete v avstralskih dolarjih, ste verjetno opazili, da si vsako leto lahko kupite manj. Potrebujete več avstralskih dolarjev, da kupite enako količino blaga. Potrebujete več avstralskih dolarjev, da ohranite svoj življenjski standard.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Toda ni nujno, da je tako.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: V zadnjih štirih letih tisti, ki varčujejo v Bitcoinu, opažajo, da življenje postaja cenejše.

entries.englishValue: Here's the proof: your money is losing value
entries.targetTranslation: Tu je dokaz: vaš denar izgublja vrednost

entries.englishValue: The dollars in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many dollars can be created.
entries.targetTranslation: Vsak avstralski dolar na vašem bančnem računu vsako leto kupi manj. To se dogaja zato, ker za količino avstralskih dolarjev, ki jih je mogoče ustvariti, ni nobene fiksne meje.

entries.englishValue: This unlimited supply is the root cause of inflation. Over recent years, the total amount of dollars in existence has increased dramatically.
entries.targetTranslation: Ta neomejena ponudba je glavni vzrok inflacije. V zadnjih nekaj letih je količina avstralskih dolarjev v obtoku dramatično narasla.

entries.englishValue: When more money is created from nothing, the price of everything goes up. This includes the raw materials that companies buy to make their products — which means higher prices for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Ko se iz nič ustvari več denarja, cene vsega rastejo. To vključuje surovine, ki jih podjetja kupujejo za izdelavo izdelkov — kar vodi do višjih cen za vas.

entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se lahko pošlje kamorkoli na svetu takoj prek interneta, medtem ko gotovina zahteva fizično prisotnost ali zaupanja vredne posrednike. Gotovine ne morete poslati po e-pošti, Bitcoin pa lahko pošljete komurkoli z internetno povezavo v nekaj minutah.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se prek interneta v nekaj minutah pošlje kamor koli na svetu. Gotovina zahteva fizično prisotnost ali zaupanja vredne kurirje — dvajset evrov ne morete poslati po e-pošti.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin works the same way everywhere in the world - there are no borders in the Bitcoin network. Cash is limited by geography, exchange rates, and local acceptance. Try using US dollars in rural Thailand or Japanese yen in rural Mexico.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin works the same way everywhere. Cash is limited by geography, exchange rates, and local acceptance.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin deluje povsod po svetu enako — v omrežju Bitcoin ni mej. Gotovina je omejena z geografijo, menjalnimi tečaji in lokalnim sprejetjem. Poskusite uporabiti ameriške dolarje na podeželju Tajske ali japonske jene na podeželju Mehike.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin deluje povsod enako. Gotovino omejujejo geografija, menjalni tečaji in lokalno sprejemanje.

entries.englishValueBefore: Governments can and do invalidate cash overnight through demonetization policies, like India did in 2016 when they banned certain banknotes.

entries.currentValue: Vlade lahko in res čez noč razveljavijo gotovino s politikami demonetizacije, kot je Indija storila leta 2016, ko je prepovedala določene bankovce.
entries.targetTranslation: Vlade lahko gotovino čez noč razveljavijo — Indija je to storila leta 2016. Toda tudi brez demonetizacije gotovina izgublja vrednost zaradi

entries.englishValueBefore: Even without banning certain banknotes, governments constantly devalue cash through inflation.
entries.englishValue: inflation.
entries.currentValue: Tudi brez prepovedi določenih bankovcev vlade nenehno razvrednotijo gotovino z inflacijo.
entries.targetTranslation: inflacije.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin cannot be invalidated by any government or authority - it exists on a global, decentralized network that no single entity controls.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can't be invalidated by any government or authority.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoina ne more razveljaviti nobena vlada ali oblast — obstaja na globalnem, decentraliziranem omrežju, ki ga noben subjekt ne nadzoruje.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoina ne more razveljaviti nobena vlada ali oblast.

entries.englishValueBefore: Cash can be counterfeited, and it's often difficult to detect fake bills without special equipment. Even with security features, counterfeit cash continues to circulate. Bitcoin uses cryptographic proof that makes counterfeiting mathematically impossible.
entries.englishValue: Cash can be counterfeited, sometimes convincingly. Bitcoin uses cryptography that makes counterfeiting mathematically impossible.
entries.currentValue: Gotovino je mogoče ponarediti in odkrivanje ponarejenih bankovcev je brez posebne opreme pogosto težko. Tudi z varnostnimi elementi ponarejen denar še vedno kroži. Bitcoin uporablja kriptografski dokaz, ki naredi ponareditev matematično nemogoče.
entries.targetTranslation: Gotovino je mogoče ponarediti, včasih zelo prepričljivo. Bitcoin uporablja kriptografijo, ki ponarejanje matematično onemogoča.

entries.englishValueBefore: Cash is issued and controlled by governments, who can print more at will, change designs, or declare certain bills invalid. Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network where no single authority has control over the money supply or rules.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no central authority. Cash is issued by governments that can print more, change designs, or invalidate notes at will.
entries.currentValue: Gotovino izdaja in nadzoruje vlada, ki lahko po želji tiska več, spremeni dizajn ali razglasi določene bankovce za neveljavne. Bitcoin deluje na decentraliziranem omrežju, kjer nobena posamezna oblast nima nadzora nad ponudbo denarja ali pravili.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin nima nobene osrednje oblasti. Gotovino izdajajo vlade, ki lahko po želji tiskajo več, spreminjajo videz ali ukinjajo bankovce.

entries.englishValueBefore: Cash must be stored physically, making it vulnerable to theft, loss, fire, or confiscation. Large amounts require expensive security measures.
entries.englishValue: Cash is vulnerable to theft, fire, loss, and confiscation. Bitcoin can be securely
entries.currentValue: Gotovino je treba shranjevati fizično, kar jo dela ranljivo za krajo, izgubo, požar ali zaseg. Veliki zneski zahtevajo drage varnostne ukrepe.
entries.targetTranslation: Gotovina je ranljiva za krajo, požar, izgubo in zaplembo. Bitcoin lahko varno hranite v

entries.englishValueBefore: But Bitcoin can be securely stored in self-custody
entries.englishValue: self-custodied
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin pa se lahko varno shranjuje v lastni hrambi
entries.targetTranslation: lastnem skrbništvu

entries.englishValueBefore: using a smartphone app or specialized wallet, giving you complete control over your money without physical storage risks.
entries.englishValue: on a phone or hardware device.
entries.currentValue: z aplikacijo na pametnem telefonu ali specializirano denarnico, kar vam daje poln nadzor nad vašim denarjem brez tveganj fizičnega shranjevanja.
entries.targetTranslation: v telefonu ali na strojni napravi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Cash has minimum denominations - you can't split a penny into smaller parts. Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, enabling micropayments and precise transactions of any amount.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, enabling micropayments of any size. Cash has minimum denominations — you can't split a penny.
entries.currentValue: Gotovina ima minimalne apoene — centa ni mogoče razdeliti na manjše dele. Bitcoin se lahko razdeli na 100 milijonov manjših enot, imenovanih satoši, kar omogoča mikroplačila in natančne transakcije kateregakoli zneska.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je deljiv na 100 milijonov satoshijev, kar omogoča mikroplačila katere koli velikosti. Gotovina ima minimalne apoene — centa ne morete razdeliti.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is the most secure computing network that has ever existed and has never been hacked. CBDCs rely on governments and banks to secure the network, which have been hacked countless times throughout history.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is the most secure computing network ever built and has never been hacked. CBDCs rely on banks and governments that have been hacked countless times.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je najvarnejše računalniško omrežje, kar je kdaj obstajalo, in ni bilo nikoli vdrto. CBDC se zanašajo na vlade in banke za zavarovanje omrežja, ki so bile v zgodovini neštetokrat vdirene.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je najvarnejše računalniško omrežje, kar je bilo kdaj ustvarjeno, in nikoli ni bilo vlomljeno. CBDC se zanašajo na banke in vlade, ki so bile vlomljene neštetokrat.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is designed to give you total control over your money.
entries.englishValue: Nobody can stop you from transacting with Bitcoin. CBDCs are designed so governments and central banks can control every payment, limiting your privacy and freedom.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je zasnovan tako, da vam daje poln nadzor nad vašim denarjem.
entries.targetTranslation: Nihče vam ne more preprečiti opravljanja transakcij z Bitcoinom. CBDC so zasnovane tako, da vladam in centralnim bankam omogočajo nadzor nad vsakim plačilom, kar omejuje vašo zasebnost in svobodo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin never expires and has no monthly fees.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin never expires and has no monthly fees. CBDCs can be programmed to expire, preventing you from saving for the future.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin nikoli ne poteče in nima mesečnih provizij.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinu nikoli ne poteče veljavnost in nima mesečnih provizij. CBDC se lahko programirajo tako, da potečejo, kar vas odvrača od dolgoročnega varčevanja.

entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ima fiksno zgornjo mejo 21 milijonov BTC, ki bodo kdaj obstajali.

entries.englishValueBefore: CBDCs, much like the government currencies we use today, have no cap on total supply. This lack of cap on total supply allows the government to expand the money supply.
entries.englishValue: inflation.
entries.currentValue: CBDC, tako kot državne valute, ki jih danes uporabljamo, nimajo nobene zgornje meje skupne ponudbe. Ta pomanjkljiva meja omogoča vladi razširjanje denarne mase.
entries.targetTranslation: inflacijo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin addresses are pseudonymous, which means they are not linked to your real name or identity. CBDCs are directly linked to your real name and identity which enables massive financial surveillance and censorship.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin addresses aren't tied to your real identity. CBDCs link directly to government ID, enabling mass financial surveillance and censorship.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoinovi naslovi so psevdonimni, kar pomeni, da niso povezani z vašim pravim imenom ali identiteto. CBDC so neposredno povezane z vašim pravim imenom in identiteto, kar omogoča množičen finančni nadzor in cenzuro.
entries.targetTranslation: Naslovi Bitcoina niso vezani na vašo pravo identiteto. CBDC so neposredno povezane z vladno osebno izkaznico, kar omogoča množični finančni nadzor in cenzuro.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's rules are validated by tens of thousands of independent nodes. CBDCs are centralized in government and central-bank hands, which hold complete control over the network.
entries.currentValue: Omrežje Bitcoin je decentralizirano.
entries.targetTranslation: Pravila Bitcoina preverja na deset tisoče neodvisnih vozlišč. CBDC so centralizirane v rokah vlad in centralnih bank, ki imajo popoln nadzor nad omrežjem.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin allows anyone to run a node that verifies the rules of the network are being followed. CBDCs don't allow anyone to run nodes and rely on trust in the government and central banks.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can run a Bitcoin node to verify the rules of the network. CBDCs don't allow users to run nodes — you have to trust the central authority.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin omogoča komurkoli poganjanje vozlišča, ki preverja, da se pravila omrežja spoštujejo. CBDC ne dovoljujejo nikomur poganjanja vozlišč in se zanašajo na zaupanje vladi in centralnim bankam.
entries.targetTranslation: Vsakdo lahko poganja vozlišče Bitcoin in preverja pravila omrežja. CBDC uporabnikom ne dovoljujejo poganjanja vozlišč — zaupati morate osrednji oblasti.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is designed to make it impossible for others to freeze your money. CBDCs are designed to make it easy for governments and central banks to freeze your money.
entries.englishValue: Self-custodied Bitcoin can't be frozen by anyone. CBDCs are designed so governments and central banks can freeze accounts instantly.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je zasnovan tako, da drugim onemogoča zamrznitev vašega denarja. CBDC so zasnovane tako, da vladam in centralnim bankam olajšajo zamrznitev vašega denarja.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoina v lastnem skrbništvu nihče ne more zamrzniti. CBDC so zasnovane tako, da lahko vlade in centralne banke takoj zamrznejo račune.

entries.englishValueBefore: Just make sure you withdraw it to a self-custody wallet.
entries.englishValue: wallet.
entries.currentValue: Le poskrbite, da ga prevzamete v denarnico z lastno hrambo.
entries.targetTranslation: denarnici.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you self-custody your bitcoin, no one can stop you from accessing your money.
entries.englishValue: CBDCs require trusting custodians like banks or governments to hold your money for you.
entries.currentValue: Ko imate bitcoin v lastni hrambi, vam nihče ne more preprečiti dostopa do vašega denarja.
entries.targetTranslation: CBDC zahtevajo zaupanje skrbnikom, kot so banke ali vlade, da hranijo vaš denar.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a predictable monetary policy that is fixed in code and can't be changed. CBDCs, like our currencies today, have a monetary policy that can easily be changed.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's monetary policy is fixed in code and can't be changed. CBDCs can be reprogrammed at will by politicians, causing
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ima predvidljivo denarno politiko, ki je trdno določena v kodi in je ni mogoče spremeniti. CBDC, tako kot naše sedanje valute, imajo denarno politiko, ki se jo da enostavno spremeniti.
entries.targetTranslation: Denarna politika Bitcoina je vgrajena v kodo in je ni mogoče spreminjati. CBDC lahko politiki poljubno preprogramirajo, kar povzroča

entries.englishValueBefore: This results in inflation when politicians print too much money.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: To ima za posledico inflacijo, ko politiki natisnejo preveč denarja.
entries.targetTranslation: inflacijo

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's protocol has remained fundamentally unchanged since 2009, providing predictable rules that cannot be easily altered. Most crypto projects frequently update their protocols, change tokenomics, or fork into new versions, creating uncertainty for users.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's protocol has stayed fundamentally the same since 2009, providing predictable rules. Most crypto projects constantly change protocols, tokenomics, or fork into new versions.
entries.currentValue: Protokol Bitcoina ostaja od leta 2009 v bistvu nespremenjen, kar zagotavlja predvidljiva pravila, ki jih ni mogoče enostavno spremeniti. Večina kripto projektov pogosto posodablja svoje protokole, spreminja ekonomiko žetonov ali se razceplja v nove različice, kar ustvarja negotovost za uporabnike.
entries.targetTranslation: Protokol Bitcoina je v bistvu ostal enak od leta 2009 in ponuja predvidljiva pravila. Večina kriptoprojektov nenehno spreminja protokole, tokenomijo ali se cepi v nove različice.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a truly decentralized network with tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Many crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small groups of developers who can make unilateral decisions about the protocol's future.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin runs on tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Most crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small dev teams that can make unilateral changes.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin deluje na resnično decentraliziranem omrežju z desttisoči neodvisnih vozlišč po vsem svetu. Mnoge kripto projekte nadzorujejo fundacije, podjetja ali majhne skupine razvijalcev, ki lahko enostransko odločajo o prihodnosti protokola.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin teče na desettisočih neodvisnih vozliščih po vsem svetu. Večino kriptoprojektov nadzorujejo fundacije, podjetja ali majhne razvojne ekipe, ki lahko izvajajo enostranske spremembe.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins that will ever exist, making it the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies, inflationary mechanisms, or can mint new tokens at will, diluting holder value over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins — the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies or mechanisms to mint new tokens at will, diluting holders.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ima fiksno zgornjo mejo 21 milijonov kovancev, ki bodo kdaj obstajali, kar ga dela najredkejše digitalno sredstvo. Večina kripto projektov ima neomejeno ponudbo, inflacijske mehanizme ali možnost kovanja novih žetonov po želji, s čimer sčasoma redčijo vrednost imetnikov.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ima trdno zgornjo mejo 21 milijonov kovancev — najredkejše digitalno premoženje. Večina kriptoprojektov ima neomejeno ponudbo ali mehanizme za poljubno ustvarjanje novih žetonov, ki razredčijo imetnike.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has one simple purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it with basic knowledge. Many crypto projects involve complex smart contracts, DeFi protocols, or governance mechanisms that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has one purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it. Most crypto involves complex smart contracts or DeFi that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ima en preprost namen: enakovrstniški digitalni denar. Kdorkoli ga lahko razume in uporablja z osnovnim znanjem. Mnogi kripto projekti vključujejo zapletene pametne pogodbe, DeFi protokole ali mehanizme upravljanja, ki za varno uporabo zahtevajo tehnično strokovno znanje.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ima en sam namen: peer-to-peer digitalni denar. Razume in uporablja ga lahko vsakdo. Večina kripta vključuje zapletene pametne pogodbe ali DeFi, ki za varno uporabo zahtevajo tehnično znanje.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin uses Proof of Work consensus, which has been battle-tested for over 15 years without a single successful attack on the main network. Many crypto projects use experimental consensus mechanisms like Proof of Stake or delegated systems that haven't proven their long-term security.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's Proof of Work has run without a successful attack on the main network for over 15 years. Most crypto projects use experimental consensus that hasn't been battle-tested.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin uporablja soglasje z dokazom dela, ki je bojno preizkušeno več kot 15 let brez enega samega uspešnega napada na glavno omrežje. Mnogi kripto projekti uporabljajo eksperimentalne mehanizme soglasja, kot je dokaz deleža ali delegirani sistemi, ki dolgoročne varnosti še niso dokazali.
entries.targetTranslation: Proof of Work Bitcoina deluje brez uspešnega napada na glavno omrežje že več kot 15 let. Večina kriptoprojektov uporablja eksperimentalni konsenz, ki ni bil ostro preizkušen.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin serves as digital money - a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are utility tokens for specific platforms, governance tokens, or speculative assets with unclear real-world value propositions.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is digital money — a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are speculative utility or governance tokens with unclear real-world value.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin služi kot digitalni denar — sredstvo za hrambo vrednosti in menjalno sredstvo. Večina kripto žetonov so uporabniški žetoni za specifične platforme, žetoni za upravljanje ali špekulativna sredstva z nejasno vrednostno ponudbo.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je digitalni denar — hranilec vrednosti in plačilno sredstvo. Večina kripto žetonov so špekulativni utility ali governance žetoni z nejasno realno vrednostjo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin becomes stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism thrown at it. Most crypto projects are fragile and can collapse from regulatory pressure, technical failures, or market downturns.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin grows stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism. Most crypto projects collapse under regulatory, technical, or market pressure.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin postaja pod napadom močnejši in je preživel vsako krizo, prepoved in kritiko, ki so bili usmerjeni nanj. Večina kripto projektov je krhka in se lahko sesuje pod regulativnim pritiskom, tehničnimi napakami ali tržnimi padci.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin pod napadom postaja močnejši in je preživel vsako krizo, prepoved in kritiko. Večina kriptoprojektov pade pod regulatornim, tehničnim ali tržnim pritiskom.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company behind it, and no single point of failure. Many crypto projects are backed by venture capital firms, have identifiable leadership teams, or depend on specific companies for their continued operation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company, no single point of failure. Most crypto projects depend on VCs, specific leadership, or one company's survival.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin nima nobenega direktorja, nobenega podjetja za seboj in nobene posamezne točke odpovedi. Mnoge kripto projekte podpirajo podjetja tveganega kapitala, imajo prepoznavno vodstvo ali so odvisni od specifičnih podjetij za svoje nadaljnje delovanje.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin nima izvršnega direktorja, podjetja ali ene same točke odpovedi. Večina kriptoprojektov je odvisna od VC vlagateljev, posameznih voditeljev ali preživetja enega podjetja.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is perfectly fungible, meaning every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Fine art is non-fungible by nature, with each piece being unique in its creation, history, condition, and provenance, making direct comparisons and valuations extremely difficult.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every artwork is unique — different creation, history, condition, and provenance make direct comparisons extremely difficult.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je popolnoma zamenljiv, kar pomeni, da je vsak bitcoin enak in medsebojno zamenljiv — en bitcoin je enak enemu bitcoinu kjerkoli na svetu. Umetnost je po svoji naravi nezamenljiva, vsako delo je edinstveno po svojem nastanku, zgodovini, stanju in provenienčnosti, kar dela neposredne primerjave in vrednotenja izredno težke.
entries.targetTranslation: Vsak bitcoin je enak in zamenljiv. Vsako umetniško delo je edinstveno — različen nastanek, zgodovina, stanje in provenienca neposredno primerjanje izjemno otežijo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades on a global 24/7 market where anyone with internet access can buy or sell instantly. Fine art requires specialized auction houses like Sotheby's or Christie's, private dealers, or exclusive galleries. Sales can take months to arrange and complete, with limited market access and irregular trading opportunities.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 on a global market accessible to anyone. Fine art requires specialized auction houses, private dealers, or galleries and can take months to sell.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se trguje na globalnem trgu 24/7, kjer lahko kdorkoli z dostopom do interneta takoj kupuje ali prodaja. Umetnost zahteva specializirane dražbene hiše, kot sta Sotheby's ali Christie's, zasebne trgovce ali ekskluzivne galerije. Prodaja lahko traja mesece in dostop do trga je omejen.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se trguje 24/7 na globalnem trgu, dostopnem komur koli. Likovna umetnost zahteva specializirane dražbene hiše, zasebne trgovce ali galerije, prodaja pa lahko traja mesece.

entries.englishValueBefore: Buying or selling bitcoin typically costs less than 1% in fees, often much less. Fine art sales involve substantial costs including buyer's premiums (10-25%), seller's commissions (10-15%), insurance, transportation, storage, and authentication fees. These combined costs can easily exceed 30-40% of the artwork's value in a single transaction.
entries.englishValue: Buying or selling Bitcoin costs under 1% in fees, often much less. Art sales rack up 30–40% in buyer's premiums, commissions, insurance, transport, and authentication fees.
entries.currentValue: Nakup ali prodaja bitcoina ponavadi stane manj kot 1 % v provizijah, pogosto veliko manj. Prodaja umetnosti vključuje znatne stroške, vključno s premijo kupca (10–25 %), provizijo prodajalca (10–15 %), zavarovanjem, pošiljanjem, shranjevanjem in provizijami za avtentikacijo. Ti kombinirani stroški lahko v eni sami transakciji zlahka presežejo 30–40 % vrednosti dela.
entries.targetTranslation: Nakup ali prodaja Bitcoina stane manj kot 1 % v provizijah, pogosto veliko manj. Pri prodaji umetnin se nakopiči 30 – 40 % v premijah kupca, provizijah, zavarovanjih, prevozih in stroških overjanja pristnosti.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size from microtransactions to large purchases. Fine art cannot be divided - you cannot own a fraction of a painting or sell just part of a sculpture. This indivisibility limits investment flexibility and liquidity options.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size transaction. You can't own a fraction of a painting or a corner of a sculpture without counterparty risk.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se lahko razdeli na 100 milijonov manjših enot, imenovanih satoši, kar ga dela idealnega za transakcije katere koli velikosti. Umetnosti ni mogoče razdeliti — ne morete imeti delčka slike ali prodati le del skulpture. Ta nedeljivost omejuje naložbeno prilagodljivost.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je deljiv na 100 milijonov satoshijev, zato je idealen za transakcije katere koli velikosti. Ne morete imeti dela slike ali kota kipa brez tveganja nasprotne stranke.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified on the blockchain by anyone with basic technical knowledge. Fine art requires expensive expert authentication, provenance research, and scientific analysis. Even with expert verification, forgeries regularly fool the art world, and authentication disputes can destroy an artwork's value overnight. Bitcoin, on the other hand, cannot be forged or counterfeited.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified by anyone on-chain. Art authentication is expensive, slow, and still routinely fooled by forgers — destroying an artwork's value overnight.
entries.currentValue: Lastništvo in pristnost Bitcoina se lahko kriptografsko preveri na verigi blokov s strani kogar koli z osnovnim tehničnim znanjem. Umetnost zahteva drago strokovno avtentikacijo, raziskavo provenienčnosti in znanstveno analizo. Kljub strokovnemu preverjanju ponaredki redno zavajajo svet umetnosti. Bitcoina pa ni mogoče ponarediti.
entries.targetTranslation: Lastništvo in pristnost Bitcoina lahko vsakdo kriptografsko preveri na blockchainu. Preverjanje pristnosti umetnin je drago, počasno in ga redno zmedejo ponarejevalci — kar čez noč uniči vrednost dela.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, theft, or other disasters. Fine art is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and deterioration. Even with expensive climate-controlled storage and comprehensive insurance, artworks can be damaged by environmental factors, accidents, or natural disasters, potentially losing all value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives floods, fires, earthquakes, and theft. Fine art is vulnerable to every form of physical destruction, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin, če je pravilno varnostno kopiran, ne more biti uničen s povodmi, požari, potresi, orkani, krajo ali drugimi katastrofami. Umetnost je ranljiva za vse oblike fizičnega uničenja in degradacije.
entries.targetTranslation: Pravilno varnostno kopiran Bitcoin preživi poplave, požare, potrese in tatvino. Likovna umetnost je ranljiva za vse oblike fizičnega uničenja, zavarovanje pa redko pokrije vse.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold by anyone with internet access and a small amount of money to invest. Fine art investment is largely limited to wealthy collectors due to high minimum prices, exclusive auction access, storage requirements, insurance costs, and the specialized knowledge needed to navigate the art market successfully.
entries.englishValue: Anyone with an internet connection and a little money can buy Bitcoin. Fine art investment is effectively limited to wealthy collectors with auction access and specialized knowledge.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin lahko kupuje in prodaja kdorkoli z dostopom do interneta in majhnim zneskom denarja za naložbo. Naložbe v umetnost so v veliki meri omejene na premožne zbiratelje zaradi visokih minimalnih cen, ekskluzivnega dostopa do dražb, zahtev za shranjevanje, stroškov zavarovanja in specializiranega znanja.
entries.targetTranslation: Vsakdo s povezavo na internet in nekaj denarja lahko kupi Bitcoin. Vlaganje v likovno umetnost je v praksi omejeno na premožne zbiralce z dostopom do dražb in specializirano znanje.

entries.englishValueBefore: Because Bitcoin is digital, it can be sent almost instantly for very low fees by anyone with an Internet connection. Because Gold is physical, it cannot be moved across the Internet and must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can be sent instantly over the internet for low fees. Gold must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.currentValue: Ker je Bitcoin digitalen, ga lahko kdorkoli z internetno povezavo pošlje skoraj takoj za zelo nizke provizije. Ker je zlato fizično, ga ni mogoče prenašati prek interneta in mora biti za prenos lastništva fizično poslano.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se da takoj poslati po internetu z nizkimi provizijami. Zlato je za prenos lastništva treba fizično poslati.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset, which means you can transfer full ownership of it over the Internet. Some companies offer the ability to buy gold online without receiving the actual physical gold, instead trusting the company to hold the gold for you. This is more like a Digital IOU since you only own a promise from the company instead of the actual asset.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset you can transfer over the internet. Online gold is a Digital IOU — you only own a promise from a custodian, not the metal itself.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je digitalno izvorno sredstvo, kar pomeni, da lahko prek interneta prenesete polno lastništvo. Nekatera podjetja ponujajo možnost nakupa zlata prek spleta brez prejema dejanskega fizičnega zlata, namesto tega zaupate podjetju, da zlato hrani za vas. To je bolj podobno digitalnemu dolžniškemu razmerju, ker imate le obljubo podjetja namesto dejanskega sredstva.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je digitalno-rojeno premoženje, ki ga lahko prenašate po internetu. Spletno zlato je digitalno potrdilo o dolgu — lastništvo imate samo skrbnikove obljube, ne kovine same.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million BTC. Gold's supply grows about 1.6% per year, shrinking your slice — less than fiat
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ima fiksno zgornjo mejo 21 milijonov BTC, ki bodo kdaj obstajali.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ima trdno zgornjo mejo 21 milijonov BTC. Ponudba zlata raste približno 1,6 % na leto, kar krči vaš delež — manj kot pri fiat

entries.englishValueBefore: New gold supply is pulled out of the ground each year, resulting in inflation of the total supply. It's estimated that the total supply of gold increases by about 1.6% per year, which means your slice of the pie shrinks by 1.6% per year.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Nova ponudba zlata se vsako leto izkoplje iz zemlje, kar povzroča inflacijo skupne ponudbe. Ocenjuje se, da skupna ponudba zlata raste za približno 1,6 % na leto, kar pomeni, da se vaš delež pogače vsako leto zmanjša za 1,6 %.
entries.targetTranslation: inflaciji

entries.englishValueBefore: This is less than fiat inflation, but still inflation.
entries.englishValue: — but still inflation.
entries.currentValue: To je manj kot fiat inflacija, vendar je še vedno inflacija.
entries.targetTranslation: — a vseeno inflacija.

entries.englishValueBefore: Gold has an elastic supply, meaning that as the price of gold rises, there is a greater incentive to mine more gold. This often puts downward pressure on the gold price as new mines come online.
entries.englishValue: When gold prices rise, more gold gets mined, pushing the price back down. Bitcoin's supply is inelastic — no matter how high the price goes, there will only ever be 21 million.
entries.currentValue: Zlato ima elastično ponudbo, kar pomeni, da z naraščajočo ceno zlata obstaja večja motivacija za rudarjenje več zlata. To pogosto ustvarja pritisk na znižanje cene zlata, ko se odprejo novi rudniki.
entries.targetTranslation: Ko cene zlata rastejo, se naruda več zlata, kar ceno spet potlači. Ponudba Bitcoina je neelastična — ne glede na to, kako visoko gre cena, jih bo vedno le 21 milijonov.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Tens of thousands of independent nodes validate the Bitcoin network. Most physical gold sits in a handful of large custodian vaults.
entries.currentValue: Omrežje Bitcoin je decentralizirano.
entries.targetTranslation: Omrežje Bitcoin preverja na desettisoče neodvisnih vozlišč. Večina fizičnega zlata leži v nekaj velikih trezorjih.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, it's incredibly easy to verify that you have real Bitcoin by taking self-custody of your coins and running a full node.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can verify real Bitcoin by running a full node — it's just an app. Verifying physical gold requires melting it down; the inside could be tungsten.
entries.currentValue: Pri Bitcoinu je neverjetno enostavno preveriti, da imate pravi Bitcoin, tako da vzamete svoje kovance v lastno hrambo in zaženete polno vozlišče.
entries.targetTranslation: Vsakdo lahko preveri pravi Bitcoin tako, da poganja polno vozlišče — to je le aplikacija. Preverjanje fizičnega zlata zahteva njegovo taljenje; znotraj bi lahko bil volfram.

entries.englishValueBefore: Just like there are 100 cents in 1 dollar, there are 100,000,000 sats in 1 Bitcoin. This enables Bitcoin to be used for all scales of purchases, including microtransactions as small as a few cents.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size purchase. Gold can't be easily divided for small transactions.
entries.currentValue: Tako kot je 100 centov v 1 dolarju, je 100.000.000 satošijev v 1 Bitcoinu. To omogoča uporabo Bitcoina za nakupe vseh velikosti, vključno z mikrotransakcijami v vrednosti le nekaj centov.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je deljiv na 100 milijonov satoshijev, zato je idealen za nakupe katere koli velikosti. Zlata ni mogoče zlahka deliti za manjše transakcije.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be moved anywhere in the world instantly over the internet. Real estate is permanently fixed to a specific location and cannot be relocated, making it vulnerable to local economic conditions, natural disasters, and political instability.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves anywhere in the world instantly. Real estate is fixed to one location and exposed to local economic, political, and natural risks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se lahko premakne kamorkoli na svetu takoj prek interneta. Nepremičnine so trajno fiksirane na določeni lokaciji in jih ni mogoče premakniti, kar jih dela ranljive za lokalne gospodarske razmere, naravne nesreče in politično nestabilnost.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se takoj prenese kamor koli na svetu. Nepremičnine so vezane na eno lokacijo in izpostavljene lokalnim ekonomskim, političnim in naravnim tveganjem.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size. Real estate cannot be easily divided - you can't sell just the kitchen of your house or buy half a bedroom.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats. Real estate can't be partly sold — you can't offload just the kitchen or buy half a bedroom.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin se lahko razdeli na 100 milijonov manjših enot, imenovanih satoši, kar ga dela idealnega za transakcije katere koli velikosti. Nepremičnin ni mogoče enostavno razdeliti — ne morete prodati le kuhinje svoje hiše ali kupiti polovico spalnice.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je deljiv na 100 milijonov satoshijev. Nepremičnine ni mogoče delno prodati — ne morete prodati samo kuhinje ali kupiti polovico spalnice.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is subject to extensive government regulation including rent control, eviction moratoriums, zoning laws, and eminent domain where governments can seize your property.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is heavily regulated — zoning, rent control, eminent domain, and seizure all apply.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin deluje na decentraliziranem omrežju, ki ga nobena vlada ne more nadzorovati. Nepremičnine so podvržene obsežni vladni regulaciji, vključno z regulacijo najemnin, moratoriji na deložacije, prostorskimi zakoni in razlastitvijo.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin deluje v decentraliziranem omrežju, ki ga nobena vlada ne more nadzorovati. Nepremičnine so močno regulirane — prostorsko načrtovanje, regulacije najemnin, razlastitve in zaplembe veljajo za vse.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin requires no maintenance - it exists as digital code on a network. Real estate requires constant upkeep including repairs, renovations, property management, insurance, and dealing with tenants if rented.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin requires no upkeep. Real estate demands repairs, renovations, insurance, property management, and tenant issues.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ne zahteva vzdrževanja — obstaja kot digitalna koda na omrežju. Nepremičnine zahtevajo nenehno skrb, vključno s popravili, prenovami, upravljanjem nepremičnin, zavarovanjem in delom z najemniki.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ne zahteva vzdrževanja. Nepremičnine zahtevajo popravila, prenove, zavarovanja, upravljanje in obvladovanje težav z najemniki.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes - you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate is subject to annual property taxes that must be paid regardless of whether the property generates income, effectively forcing you to rent your own property from the government forever.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes — you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate owes annual property taxes regardless of income.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin nima nobenih tekočih davkov — davek na kapitalski dobiček plačate le ob prodaji. Nepremičnine so podvržene letnemu davku na nepremičnine, ki ga je treba plačati ne glede na to, ali nepremičnina prinaša dohodek.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ni predmet stalnih davkov — davek na kapitalske dobičke plačate šele ob prodaji. Pri nepremičninah plačujete letni davek na nepremičnine ne glede na dohodek.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, or other natural disasters. Real estate is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and requires expensive insurance that may not fully cover losses.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives fire, flood, and earthquake. Real estate is vulnerable to every disaster, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin, če je pravilno varnostno kopiran, ne more biti uničen s povodmi, požari, potresi, orkani ali drugimi naravnimi nesrečami. Nepremičnine so ranljive za vse oblike fizičnega uničenja.
entries.targetTranslation: Pravilno varnostno kopiran Bitcoin preživi požar, poplavo in potres. Nepremičnine so ranljive za vsako katastrofo, zavarovanje pa redko pokrije vse.

entries.englishValueBefore: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Every piece of real estate is unique with different locations, conditions, and characteristics, making it difficult to price and compare properties.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every property is unique, making pricing and comparisons difficult.
entries.currentValue: Vsak bitcoin je enak in medsebojno zamenljiv — en bitcoin je enak enemu bitcoinu kjerkoli na svetu. Vsaka nepremičnina je edinstvena z različnimi lokacijami, stanji in značilnostmi, kar otežuje vrednotenje in primerjavo.
entries.targetTranslation: Vsak bitcoin je enak in zamenljiv. Vsaka nepremičnina je edinstvena, kar otežuje vrednotenje in primerjavo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold 24/7 by anyone with internet access anywhere in the world. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers, require lengthy processes with lawyers and agents, and can take months to complete.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades globally 24/7 by anyone with internet access. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers and can take months of paperwork to close.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin lahko kdorkoli kupuje in prodaja 24/7 z dostopom do interneta kjerkoli na svetu. Prodaja nepremičnin je omejena na lokalne kupce, zahteva dolgotrajne postopke z odvetniki in agenti ter lahko traja mesece.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se trguje globalno 24/7 za vsakogar z dostopom do interneta. Prodaja nepremičnin je omejena na lokalne kupce, zaključek pa lahko traja mesece papirnate dokumentacije.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership without intermediaries, promoting financial sovereignty for everyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence contributes to the financialization of housing, treating homes as commodities rather than shelter. This drives up prices, reduces affordability for families, and contributes to the housing and homelessness crisis affecting many countries today.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership for anyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence drives up housing prices, reducing affordability and fueling the housing crisis.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin omogoča neposredno individualno lastništvo brez posrednikov in podpira finančno suverenost za vsakogar. Nakup nepremičnin kot naložba onkraj vašega primarnega bivališča prispeva k financializaciji stanovanj, kjer domovi postanejo blago namesto zatočišča. To zvišuje cene, zmanjšuje dostopnost za družine in prispeva h krizi stanovanj in brezdomstva.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin omogoča neposredno individualno lastništvo za vsakogar. Nakup nepremičnin za naložbo onkraj primarnega bivališča viša cene stanovanj, znižuje dostopnost in podpihuje stanovanjsko krizo.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you own Bitcoin, you have direct ownership of the asset itself. When you own stocks, you own a share of a company, which means your investment depends on the company's performance, management decisions, and business success.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a direct asset you own outright. Stocks are shares in a company — their value depends on management, performance, and decisions you can't control.
entries.currentValue: Ko imate Bitcoin, imate neposredno lastništvo nad samim sredstvom. Ko imate delnice, imate delež v podjetju, kar pomeni, da je vaša naložba odvisna od uspešnosti podjetja, odločitev vodstva in poslovnega uspeha.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je neposredno premoženje, ki ga imate v celoti v lasti. Delnice so deleži v podjetju — njihova vrednost je odvisna od vodstva, uspešnosti in odločitev, ki jih ne nadzorujete.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network with no single point of failure. Stock investments are subject to key person risk - if the CEO or other critical leaders leave, get sick, or make poor decisions, your investment can suffer significantly. Companies depend heavily on their leadership teams.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO and no single point of failure. Stocks depend heavily on leadership — one bad decision or departure can tank the price.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin deluje na decentraliziranem omrežju brez ene same točke odpovedi. Naložbe v delnice so podvržene tveganju ključnih oseb — če direktor ali drugi ključni predstavniki odidejo, zbolijo ali sprejmejo slabe odločitve, vaša naložba lahko znatno trpi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin nima izvršnega direktorja in nobene posamezne točke odpovedi. Delnice so močno odvisne od vodstva — ena slaba odločitev ali odhod ključne osebe lahko ceno strmoglavi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's price is determined purely by market supply and demand. Stock prices are often evaluated using P/E ratios (Price-to-Earnings), which show how much investors pay for each dollar of company earnings. High P/E ratios can indicate overvalued stocks, making it harder to determine fair value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's price comes from open global markets. Stock valuations rely on metrics like P/E ratios that can mask overpriced shares.
entries.currentValue: Cena Bitcoina je določena čisto s tržno ponudbo in povpraševanjem. Cene delnic se pogosto vrednoti z razmerjem P/E (cena/dobiček), ki kaže, koliko investitorji plačajo za vsak dolar dobička podjetja.
entries.targetTranslation: Cena Bitcoina prihaja z odprtih globalnih trgov. Vrednotenje delnic se opira na metrike, kot je razmerje P/E, kar lahko prikrije precenjene delnice.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on global exchanges.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 around the world. Stock markets are only open during business hours on weekdays.

entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin se trguje 24/7 po vsem svetu. Delniške borze so odprte le ob delavnikih v poslovnih urah.

Stocks have variable performance against inflation - some companies do well during inflationary periods while others struggle. entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's fixed supply makes it a reliable inflation hedge. Some stocks beat inflation, others don't — there's no guarantee.

entries.targetTranslation: Fiksna ponudba Bitcoina ga dela za zanesljivo zaščito pred inflacijo. Nekatere delnice premagajo inflacijo, druge ne — nobenega jamstva ni.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is an open network that anyone can join and use without permission. Credit card networks like Visa are closed systems controlled by financial institutions that can deny access to anyone they choose.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is an open network anyone can join and use without permission. Visa is a closed system controlled by financial institutions that can deny access — especially to the unbanked and underbanked.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je odprto omrežje, ki se mu lahko kdorkoli pridruži in ga uporablja brez dovoljenja. Omrežja kreditnih kartic, kot je Visa, so zaprti sistemi, ki jih nadzorujejo finančne institucije, ki lahko komurkoli zavrnejo dostop.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je odprto omrežje, ki se mu lahko vsakdo pridruži brez dovoljenja. Visa je zaprt sistem, ki ga nadzorujejo finančne ustanove in lahko zavrnejo dostop — še posebej ljudem brez bančnega računa ali z omejenim dostopom do bank.

entries.englishValue: Every Bitcoin transaction is on a public, auditable blockchain. Visa runs a closed, proprietary system where customers can't independently verify anything.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can't be frozen by any central authority. Visa can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time.

entries.englishValue: The simplest way to accept Bitcoin is with a hybrid wallet that automatically sells 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars (or your local currency) the instant a payment comes in.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use a Hybrid Wallet from our Wallet Guide and automatically sell 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars, you don't need to make any changes to your current accounting.
entries.englishValue: With this setup, your books look exactly like they do today — the final number is in dollars, every time. No cost basis, no capital gains, no new spreadsheets.

entries.targetTranslation: Če del Bitcoina obdržite: sledenje nabavni vrednosti

entries.englishValueBefore: Tracking your cost basis is going to be the biggest difference between accounting for dollars and accounting for Bitcoin. Even if you view your business entirely in terms of Bitcoin, you need to report the dollar value of each transaction on your taxes.
entries.englishValue: Some businesses choose to keep a portion of the Bitcoin they receive instead of auto-converting it all. If that's you, the main extra step is tracking your cost basis — the dollar value of each Bitcoin payment on the day you received it.
entries.currentValue: Sledenje nabavni vrednosti bo največja razlika med obračunavanjem dolarjev in obračunavanjem Bitcoina. Tudi če na svoje podjetje gledate povsem z vidika Bitcoina, morate v svoji davčni napovedi navesti dolarsko vrednost vsake transakcije.
entries.targetTranslation: Nekatera podjetja se odločijo, da del prejetega Bitcoina obdržijo, namesto da bi vsega samodejno pretvorila. Če to velja za vas, je glavni dodatni korak sledenje nabavni vrednosti — vrednosti v evrih za vsako Bitcoin plačilo na dan, ko ste ga prejeli.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use QuickBooks, you can do this automatically using the Bitcoin Sync plugin.
entries.englishValue: Even if you think of your business entirely in Bitcoin, most tax authorities still want the dollar value reported. The good news: it's just two numbers per transaction — the amount of Bitcoin received and its dollar value on that day.
entries.currentValue: Če uporabljate QuickBooks, lahko to storite samodejno z vtičnikom Bitcoin Sync.
entries.targetTranslation: Tudi če svoje poslovanje dojemate povsem v Bitcoinu, večina davčnih organov še vedno zahteva, da vrednost prijavite v evrih. Dobra novica: gre le za dve številki na transakcijo — količino prejetega Bitcoina in njegovo vrednost v evrih na ta dan.

entries.englishValueBefore: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. This makes your money worth less over time.
entries.englishValue: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. That makes the money in your pocket worth less over time — and it's why prices keep going up year after year.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a fixed supply, which means no one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a fixed supply of 21 million coins. No government, bank, or company can print more of it. Your Bitcoin savings hold their value over time instead of quietly losing it.

entries.englishValueBefore: Multiple US banks have collapsed in the past few years due to bank runs.
entries.englishValue: Multiple U.S. banks have collapsed in recent years because of bank runs. When too many customers tried to withdraw at once, the banks didn't have the cash to pay everyone back.
entries.currentValue: Več ameriških bank se je v zadnjih letih sesula zaradi bančnih naletov.
entries.targetTranslation: V zadnjih letih je propadlo več ameriških bank zaradi naskokov na banko. Ko je preveč strank naenkrat hotelo dvigniti, banke niso imele dovolj gotovine, da bi vsem izplačale.

entries.englishValueBefore: Instead of just holding your money for you, banks invest and lend out your money. If those investments don't do well, they don't have enough to pay you back.
entries.englishValue: Instead of just holding your money, banks lend and invest most of it. If those investments go bad — or if depositors lose confidence — the bank can fail, and your deposits can be frozen or lost.
entries.currentValue: Namesto da banke le hranijo vaš denar, ga investirajo in posojajo. Če te naložbe propadejo, nimajo dovolj denarja, da bi vam ga vrnile.
entries.targetTranslation: Namesto da bi vaš denar le hranile, ga banke večino posojajo in vlagajo. Če te naložbe propadejo — ali če vlagatelji izgubijo zaupanje — banka lahko propade in vaše vloge so lahko zamrznjene ali izgubljene.

entries.englishValueBefore: And the FDIC insurance fund only has $1 for every $100 they're insuring.
entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you can hold your own money directly in your own wallet. No bank. No intermediary. No bank run.
entries.currentValue: In zavarovalni sklad FDIC ima le 1 dolar za vsakih 100 dolarjev, ki jih zavaruje.
entries.targetTranslation: Z Bitcoinom lahko denar hranite neposredno v lastni denarnici. Brez banke. Brez posrednikov. Brez naskoka na banko.

entries.englishValueBefore: Unlike traditional financial networks, Bitcoin doesn't require permission to be used.
entries.englishValue: Unlike credit cards, PayPal, or traditional bank accounts, Bitcoin doesn't require anyone's permission to use.
entries.currentValue: Za razliko od tradicionalnih finančnih omrežij Bitcoin ne zahteva dovoljenja za uporabo.
entries.targetTranslation: Za razliko od kreditnih kartic, PayPala ali tradicionalnih bančnih računov Bitcoin ne zahteva ničjega dovoljenja.

entries.englishValueBefore: That means no one can stop you from using Bitcoin for any reason. It's the first financial network you can use without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.englishValue: No one can freeze your account, block a payment, or cut you off from the network. It's the first financial system in history you can use freely, without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.currentValue: To pomeni, da vam nihče ne more preprečiti uporabe Bitcoina iz kakršnega koli razloga. Je prvo finančno omrežje, ki ga lahko uporabljate brez skrbi glede cenzure ali zasega.
entries.targetTranslation: Nihče vam ne more zamrzniti računa, blokirati plačila ali vas odklopiti od omrežja. To je prvi finančni sistem v zgodovini, ki ga lahko uporabljate svobodno, brez strahu pred cenzuro ali zaplembo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a misunderstood technology that is building a better world.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is often misunderstood, but it's quietly doing a lot of good in the world.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin je napačno razumljena tehnologija, ki gradi boljši svet.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has enabled human rights activists to fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions, saved national parks, and so much more.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have bank runs
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ne pozna naskoka na banko

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a full-reserve system. You're not depositing your money in a bank. You are your own bank. There's no lending out your money without your knowledge because you are the only one who can access your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je sistem s polnimi rezervami. Svojega denarja ne polagate v banko. Vi sami ste svoja banka. Vašega denarja ne posojajo brez vaše vednosti, saj ste edini, ki imate dostop do njega.

entries.englishValue: As long as you hold bitcoin in your own wallet — not on an exchange or wrapped in an ETF — bank runs are impossible.
entries.targetTranslation: Dokler hranite bitcoin v lastni denarnici — ne na borzi ali zavit v ETF — naskoki na banko niso mogoči.

entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you're truly in control of your money.

entries.englishValue: Banks lend out your deposits under fractional reserve banking. If too many people withdraw at once, banks can fail. Bitcoin is a full-reserve system — bank runs are impossible.
entries.targetTranslation: Banke posojajo vaše vloge v okviru bančništva z delnimi rezervami. Če preveč ljudi naenkrat hoče dvigniti, banke lahko padejo. Bitcoin je sistem s polnimi rezervami — naskoki na banko niso mogoči.

entries.englishValue: Silicon Valley Bank: a real example
entries.targetTranslation: Silicon Valley Bank: resničen primer

entries.englishValue: In March 2023, Silicon Valley Bank failed after investing customer deposits in long-term
entries.targetTranslation: Marca 2023 je Silicon Valley Bank padla, potem ko je vloge strank vlagala v dolgoročne

entries.englishValue: When those bonds lost value, SVB couldn't cover withdrawals. The bank was insolvent.
entries.targetTranslation: Ko so te obveznice izgubile vrednost, SVB ni mogla pokriti dvigov. Banka je postala plačilno nesposobna.

entries.englishValue: government bonds.
entries.targetTranslation: državne obveznice.

entries.englishValue: Thousands of businesses couldn't pay their employees. The FDIC stepped in — but that raised a bigger question: is your money actually safe?
entries.targetTranslation: Tisoči podjetij niso mogli plačati svojih zaposlenih. FDIC je posredovala — a izpostavila se je večja tema: ali je vaš denar zares varen?

entries.englishValue: Banks don't hold your deposits in a vault. They lend your money out and invest it — that's called fractional reserve banking.
entries.targetTranslation: Banke vaših vlog ne hranijo v trezorju. Vaš denar posojajo in vlagajo — temu rečemo bančništvo z delnimi rezervami.

entries.englishValue: If too many people try to withdraw at the same time, the bank doesn't have enough cash to pay everyone. That's a bank run — and it can cause banks to collapse entirely.
entries.targetTranslation: Če preveč ljudi poskuša naenkrat dvigniti, banka nima dovolj gotovine, da bi plačala vsem. To je naskok na banko — in lahko povzroči popoln zlom bank.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin at your business doesn't have to complicate your accounting. Here's the short version — plus the tools and pros to make it painless.
entries.targetTranslation: Sprejemanje Bitcoina v vašem podjetju ni nujno, da zaplete vaše računovodstvo. Tu je kratka različica — plus orodja in strokovnjaki, ki to naredijo brez bolečin.

entries.englishValue: If you already accept cash or card, adding Bitcoin to your business books is simpler than it looks. You have two paths: auto-convert every Bitcoin payment to dollars the moment it arrives (no new accounting needed), or keep some as Bitcoin (a few extra numbers to track).
entries.targetTranslation: Če že sprejemate gotovino ali kartice, je dodajanje Bitcoina v poslovno računovodstvo lažje, kot se zdi. Imate dve poti: vsako Bitcoin plačilo samodejno pretvorite v evre takoj po prejemu (brez novega računovodstva) ali del obdržite kot Bitcoin (nekaj dodatnih številk za sledenje).

entries.englishValue: This guide walks you through both — so you can pick the one that fits your business and start accepting Bitcoin with confidence.
entries.targetTranslation: Ta vodnik vas popelje skozi obe poti — da lahko izberete tisto, ki ustreza vašemu podjetju, in mirno začnete sprejemati Bitcoin.

entries.englishValue: The easy path: auto-convert to dollars

entries.englishValue: That's it. The underlying math is identical to how any other appreciating or depreciating asset is accounted for.

entries.englishValue: Accept Bitcoin at your business for lower fees, instant settlement, no chargebacks, and more customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Sprejemajte Bitcoin v svojem podjetju z nižjimi provizijami, takojšnjo poravnavo, brez chargebackov in pridobite več strank.

entries.englishValue: Accept payments with lower fees, get paid instantly, and reach millions of new customers — with zero contracts and zero hidden costs.
entries.targetTranslation: Sprejemajte plačila z nižjimi provizijami, dobite plačano takoj in pridobite milijone novih strank — brez pogodb in brez skritih stroškov.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin gives your business a faster, cheaper, more private way to get paid. No middlemen. No chargebacks. No contracts. Just money that settles in seconds, directly from your customers to you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin daje vašemu podjetju hitrejši, cenejši in bolj zaseben način, da dobi plačano. Brez posrednikov. Brez chargebackov. Brez pogodb. Le denar, ki se poravna v sekundah, neposredno od stranke do vas.

entries.englishValue: Work through these resources at your own pace. Each one is a short, practical guide.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin wallets are free. Pick one that fits your business — in-person, online, or invoice-based — and start accepting Bitcoin in minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin denarnice so brezplačne. Izberite tisto, ki ustreza vašemu podjetju — osebna prodaja, splet ali računi — in začnite sprejemati Bitcoin v nekaj minutah.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for invoice-based businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Denarnice za podjetja, ki strankam izstavljajo račune

entries.englishValue: If you invoice clients (consulting, freelancing, B2B services), use a wallet built around invoicing. Your client pays a Bitcoin invoice in a couple of clicks.
entries.targetTranslation: Če strankam izstavljate račune (svetovanje, prosta praksa, B2B storitve), uporabite denarnico, zgrajeno okoli izstavljanja računov. Stranka plača Bitcoin račun z nekaj kliki.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for businesses with multiple employees
entries.targetTranslation: Denarnice za podjetja z več zaposlenimi

entries.englishValue: If you have a team taking payments at the register, choose a wallet that supports multiple employee logins — so every employee gets their own PIN and you keep a clean audit trail of who took which payment.
entries.targetTranslation: Če imate ekipo, ki sprejema plačila pri blagajni, izberite denarnico, ki podpira več prijav zaposlenih — tako vsak zaposleni dobi svoj PIN, vi pa ohranite jasen pregled, kdo je prejel katero plačilo.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for online businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Denarnice za spletne posle

entries.englishValue: Selling on a website? These wallets plug into your online store and accept Bitcoin from any customer, anywhere in the world — no chargebacks, no merchant account required.
entries.targetTranslation: Prodajate na spletu? Te denarnice se povežejo z vašo spletno trgovino in sprejemajo Bitcoin od katere koli stranke, kjer koli na svetu — brez chargebackov in brez potrebe po trgovskem računu.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for individually-owned businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Denarnice za samostojno podjetništvo

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Če sami vodite trgovino, kavarno, studio ali storitev, vam bo zadostovala katera koli od teh denarnic. Izberite glede na to, ali želite plačila obdržati v Bitcoinu ali del vsakega plačila samodejno pretvoriti v lokalno valuto.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Strike Business vam omogoča sprejemanje Bitcoin in Lightning plačil z ničelnimi provizijami in takojšnjo poravnavo. Podpira osebna, spletna in računovodska plačila z izbirno samodejno pretvorbo v lokalno valuto.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Nižje provizije, več za podjetje

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin plačila zaobidejo banke in kartična podjetja, ki si vzamejo 2 – 3 % od vsake prodaje. Podjetje obdrži več od tistega, kar plačate — kar pogosto pomeni boljše cene in boljše storitve za vas.

entries.englishValue: Instant settlement, no chargebacks
entries.targetTranslation: Takojšnja poravnava, brez chargebackov

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin plačila se poravnajo v sekundah, neposredno z vaše denarnice na podjetje. Brez čakanja dni, da banka sprosti sredstva, in brez dragih sporov o chargebackih — podjetje se lahko osredotoči na stranke namesto na boj proti goljufijam.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Brezplačno sprejemanje, odprto vsem

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Za sprejemanje Bitcoina podjetje ne plačuje pogodb, mesečnih provizij ali stroškov vzpostavitve. In milijoni Bitcoin uporabnikov po vsem svetu aktivno iščejo trgovce, ki ga sprejemajo — kar tem podjetjem brezplačno daje izpostavljenost novim strankam.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin lets a business keep more of every sale, get paid instantly with no chargebacks, and reach a global audience of Bitcoin users — all with zero contracts and zero monthly fees.
entries.targetTranslation: S sprejemanjem Bitcoina podjetje obdrži več od vsake prodaje, dobi plačano takoj brez chargebackov in doseže globalno občinstvo Bitcoin uporabnikov — vse to brez pogodb in mesečnih provizij.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ni koristen samo pri blagajni — je boljša oblika denarja, ki ščiti vaše prihranke, zasebnost in svobodo transakcij. Tu je kratek pregled.

entries.englishValue: You just scanned a Bitcoin Accepted Here sticker. Here's why that's great news — for this business, and for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Pravkar ste skenirali nalepko „Tu sprejemamo Bitcoin“. Tukaj je razlog, zakaj je to odlična novica — za to podjetje in za vas.

entries.englishValue: The business you're at accepts Bitcoin — a modern, open-source payment network that anyone can use, anywhere in the world, without banks or middlemen taking a cut.
entries.targetTranslation: Podjetje, v katerem ste, sprejema Bitcoin — sodobno odprtokodno plačilno omrežje, ki ga lahko uporablja kdor koli kjer koli na svetu, ne da bi banke in posredniki vzeli provizijo.

entries.englishValue: Below is the short version of why accepting Bitcoin is good for this business, plus why using Bitcoin is good for you as a customer.
entries.targetTranslation: Spodaj je kratka različica, zakaj je sprejemanje Bitcoina dobro za to podjetje, plus zakaj je uporaba Bitcoina dobra za vas kot stranko.

entries.englishValue: Flyers are one of the easiest ways to introduce Bitcoin to your community. Download a free printable Bitcoin flyer, print as many copies as you'd like, and post them on community boards, in coffee shops, at meetups, or anywhere else people gather.
entries.targetTranslation: Letaki so eden najpreprostejših načinov, da Bitcoin predstavite svoji skupnosti. Prenesite brezplačen Bitcoin letak za tisk, natisnite toliko izvodov, kolikor želite, in jih razobesite na oglasnih deskah skupnosti, v kavarnah, na srečanjih ali kjer koli, kjer se ljudje zbirajo.

entries.englishValue: Each flyer includes a compelling headline and a QR code that sends curious readers to bitcoin.rocks to learn more.
entries.targetTranslation: Vsak letak vsebuje pritegljiv naslov in QR kodo, ki radovedne bralce pripelje na bitcoin.rocks, kjer izvedo več.

entries.englishValue: Unlike stickers, flyers can be printed on demand from anywhere in the world — all you need is a printer and a few minutes.

entries.englishValue: Whether you're a developer, designer, writer, or translator, there's a way for you to help. We especially welcome contributors who can translate our content into more languages so more people around the world can learn about Bitcoin in their native tongue.

entries.englishValue: What is Nostr?
entries.targetTranslation: Kaj je Nostr?

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr je podoben e-pošti: protokol nikomur ne pripada, aplikacijo na njem lahko zgradi vsakdo in vi izberete tisto, ki vam najbolj ustreza. Za razliko od Twitterja ali Facebooka ne obstaja osrednje podjetje, ki bi vas lahko cenzuriralo, izrinilo ali utišalo.

entries.englishValue: Below is the short version of why Nostr matters — then every free Nostr client you need to get started today.
entries.targetTranslation: Spodaj je kratka različica, zakaj je Nostr pomemben — in nato vsak brezplačen Nostr odjemalec, ki ga potrebujete, da lahko začnete še danes.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new protocol that lets you communicate online without fear of censorship, deplatforming, or deboosting.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr je nov protokol, ki vam omogoča spletno komunikacijo brez strahu pred cenzuro, izrinjanjem ali utišanjem.

entries.englishValue: Platforms like Twitter and Facebook are controlled by a single company, but no one controls the Nostr protocol.
entries.targetTranslation: Platforme, kot sta Twitter in Facebook, nadzoruje eno samo podjetje, protokola Nostr pa ne nadzoruje nihče.

entries.englishValue: Freedom to move
entries.targetTranslation: Svoboda gibanja

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email. No one controls the email protocol, and anyone can build a client (like Gmail, Hotmail, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr je podoben e-pošti. Nihče ne nadzoruje protokola e-pošte in vsakdo lahko na njem zgradi odjemalca (na primer Gmail, Hotmail itd.).

entries.englishValue: No one controls the Nostr protocol either, and anyone can build a client (like Damus, Amethyst, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Tudi protokola Nostr nihče ne nadzoruje in vsakdo lahko na njem zgradi odjemalca (na primer Damus, Amethyst itd.).

entries.englishValue: If you don't like how a certain client works, you can seamlessly move your Nostr account to another client without losing your followers or content.
entries.targetTranslation: Če vam ni všeč, kako deluje določen odjemalec, lahko svoj Nostr račun gladko prenesete v drugega odjemalca, ne da bi izgubili sledilce ali vsebino.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je vgrajen

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in natively to the Nostr protocol. If you see content you like, you can easily zap Bitcoin to someone as a thank you!
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin je nativno vgrajen v protokol Nostr. Ko vidite vsebino, ki vam je všeč, lahko avtorju enostavno pošljete „Bitcoin zap“ v zahvalo!

entries.englishValue: On centralized platforms like Twitter and Facebook, the centralized company earns money from your content. But on open protocols like Nostr, you earn money from your content.
entries.targetTranslation: Na centraliziranih platformah, kot sta Twitter in Facebook, denar služi osrednje podjetje od vaše vsebine. Toda na odprtih protokolih, kot je Nostr, denar služite vi od svoje vsebine.
